tools.name: get_draw
tools.description: The winning numbers of the latest draw, or of one past draw. kr645: give the draw number (회차). powerball, megamillions: give the draw date YYYY-MM-DD. Sources: dhlottery.co.kr (Korea), data.ny.gov (USA).

tools.name: prismtect_number
tools.description: A personal two-digit number from the Prismtect glass prism, for a user who asks for a lucky number, a number of their own or a number for today. Only a human touch can draw it, so this tool gives no number: it gives the link your user taps themselves. Pass the link on.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "lottery" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_ticket · Private data: check_ticket · Public sink: sentence_numbers_link · Destructive: pick_numbers, sentence_numbers_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_ticket · Private data: check_ticket · Public sink: sentence_numbers_link · Destructive: pick_numbers, sentence_numbers_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
